messages:
incident-bot: Paging: Dedicated pool `northstar-enterprise` GPU utilization >95% and queue length increasing. Severity: P1. Notifying on-call. 

sre-jamie: Ack. Looking at metrics now. 

oncall-aaron: Oncall here — joining. Can we see per-tenant queueing? `curl -s http://metrics:9090/api/v1/query?query=queue_length{pool=\"northstar-enterprise\"}` returned spike for tenant:northstar (~820 requests). 

eng-lina: Seeing high KV cache churn for that tenant, lots of long-context requests. Sequence lengths trending 2.5x baseline. Possible bad load test or job backfill. 

sre-jamie: Confirmed: GPU saturation across 8/8 nodes. Autoscale policy is max=8; we've hit cap. Candidate mitigations: emergency burst (reserved spare GPUs), apply QoS throttles to low-priority jobs, or spill some traffic to compatible multi-tenant model `rwd-medium-quant`. 

support-maya: Reaching out to Northstar primary contact now (@acct-carlos). Copying customer: "We see elevated traffic impacting latency; we may apply emergency burst or degrade to a compatible smaller model. Any ongoing jobs?" :phone: 

acct-carlos: Thanks — we have a scheduled data-import that just kicked off, unexpected size. Can you pause it? We're authorizing any mitigation that avoids 10%+ error rate. 

pm-ellie: Note: emergency burst will incur overage charges under their contract but we have authority to approve within 2 hours for incident mitigation per SRE/CS agreement. I'll log approval once SRE suggests exact GPUs needed. 

eng-lina: Proposed plan: 1) throttle tenant background jobs via QoS label set `priority=low` -> rate-limit 70% 2) enable emergency burst +2 r5 GPUs from reserved pool 3) route short-chat requests to `rwd-medium-quant` fallback for 30m 4) pause non-critical backfills. 

sre-jamie: Runbook step: `./scripts/eval-burst.sh --pool northstar-enterprise --count 2 --reason \"queue pressure\"` — executing now. 

incident-bot: Action log: burst-request submitted by sre-jamie at 9945000125, approver pm-ellie. Status: pending. 

pm-ellie: Approved for 2 GPUs for up to 2 hours. Please record expected cost and ETA. :white_check_mark: 

sre-jamie: Burst request accepted by infra; new nodes booting. `kubectl get nodes | grep northstar` shows 2 new r5 nodes provisioning. ETA ~ 90s. 

incident-bot: Scaling event: nodes=+2 at 9945000219. GPU util now 84% across pool. Queue length dropping (820 -> 180). P50 latency improving from 320ms -> 110ms. 

support-maya: Customer notified: "We paused the import and enabled temporary capacity. Latency improving; monitoring closely. We'll keep you posted." 

acct-carlos: Thanks team — please keep burst active for 40 more minutes. Will cancel import restart until we get green. 

eng-lina: Also applied temporary routing to `rwd-medium-quant` for requests with context>2048; config snippet: `routes: - match: seq_len>2048 -> model: rwd-medium-quant` 

sre-jamie: Monitoring for regressions. Setting manual cooldown; will begin draining extra nodes at 9945003600 if stable. Adding postmortem owner: oncall-aaron. 

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> customer-impact reduced. Next steps: postmortem, billing exception review, autoscale policy review (consider raising max or pre-warming for scheduled imports). 

oncall-aaron: Handoff accepted. Creating incident doc and timeline. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
